title: Source Review Cleanup: covered UX bycatch stops exporting as review debt

ciFast.note: Fast verification is claimed only after v0.15.129 is pushed and the GitHub Actions run is attached.

deploy.note: Pages deploy is not claimed until the pushed v0.15.129 release completes its deploy run.

ciDeep.note: This is a narrow source review truth cleanup; focused source-ledger and package-export coverage plus normal gates are the release bar.

liveProvider.note: The release is based on a fresh deployed v0.15.128 ZIP/log audit that exported 100/100 with Texture 95 but still had covered source review notes. A fresh deployed v0.15.129 audit is still required before claiming clean provider output.

manualHuman.note: No external instructor approval is claimed by this release.

claims.summary: A fresh deployed v0.15.128 UX audit exported and locally regraded at 100/100 with zero P findings, nine trusted concept-linked source rows, and Texture 95.
proofCommands: rg -n "v0.15.128|100/100|Texture 95|nine trusted|0 P0|0 P1|0 P2" docs/V0.15.129_SOURCE_REVIEW_CAVEAT_CLEANUP_ROADMAP.md src/lib/releaseManifest.js

claims.summary: The fresh audit still exported covered source review notes even though trusted source rows covered the linked UX concepts.
proofCommands: rg -n "nine source review notes|generated syllabus placeholders|weak UX bycatch|reviewRequiredCount" docs/V0.15.129_SOURCE_REVIEW_CAVEAT_CLEANUP_ROADMAP.md src/lib/releaseManifest.js

claims.summary: Covered non-actionable review rows are pruned once trusted concept-linked source rows cover the same concepts.
Rows without trusted concept coverage remain visible as source review debt and weak rows are not promoted into trusted sourceLedger proof.
Focused source-ledger and package-export regressions cover the cleanup without changing source quality thresholds.

knownRemainingTargets: Fresh deployed v0.15.129 ZIP/log audit must prove SOURCE_REPORT.md and PACKAGE_MANIFEST.json no longer export covered false-friend or generated-placeholder review caveats.
Texture remains below the strict-clean target until a fresh provider output reaches 100/100 texture or records the next concrete repeated shingle.
Source rows must remain real, trusted, on-topic, license-safe, and concept-linked across UX and Project Management domains.
Every exported surface must agree: UI, ZIP, manifest, quality report, source report, digest logs, DOCX/PPTX files, and local regrade.
